question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{9,10,11,…,28\},$ and the set $S=\{9,10,11,…,28\}$ has $|S|=28-9+1=20$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{20}, & x=9,10,11,…,28 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $X>25$ are $26,27,28.$ There are $3$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(X>25)=3\cdot \frac{1}{20}=\frac{3}{20}.
$$
